about: The words under each plate. `title` names the work; `detail` says what it is, when it was made and where it is kept. Which file belongs to which god, and who photographed it, is in config/plates.json.

zeus.title: Zeus of Otricoli
zeus.detail: Roman marble after a Greek original of the 4th century BC. Vatican Museums, Rome.

hades.title: Bust of Hades
hades.detail: Roman marble after a Greek original of the 5th century BC. Palazzo Altemps, Rome.

hermes.title: Hermes Ingenui
hermes.detail: Roman marble after a Greek original of the 5th century BC. Vatican Museums, Rome.

hestia.title: Hestia Giustiniani
hestia.detail: Roman marble after a Greek bronze of about 470 BC. Torlonia Collection, Rome.

apollo.title: Apollo Belvedere
apollo.detail: Roman marble after a Greek bronze of the 4th century BC. Vatican Museums, Rome.

dionysus.title: Dionysus
dionysus.detail: Roman marble in the manner of Praxiteles, 4th century BC. Palazzo Altemps, Rome.

aphrodite.title: Venus de Milo
aphrodite.detail: Greek marble from the island of Melos, about 130 to 100 BC. Louvre, Paris.

ares.title: Ludovisi Ares
ares.detail: Roman marble after a Greek original of about 320 BC. Palazzo Altemps, Rome.

athena.title: Athena of Velletri
athena.detail: Roman marble bust after a Greek bronze of about 430 BC. Glyptothek, Munich.

poseidon.title: Artemision Bronze
poseidon.detail: Poseidon or Zeus, about 460 BC, found in the sea off Cape Artemision. Shown here in a modern cast of the bronze in Athens.

hera.title: Juno Ludovisi
hera.detail: Colossal Roman marble head, 1st century AD. Palazzo Altemps, Rome.

artemis.title: Diana of Versailles
artemis.detail: Roman marble after a Greek bronze of about 325 BC. Louvre, Paris.

demeter.title: Demeter
demeter.detail: Roman marble after a Greek original of the 4th century BC. Palazzo Altemps, Rome.

hephaestus.title: Vulcan
hephaestus.detail: Bertel Thorvaldsen, marble, modelled in 1838. Thorvaldsens Museum, Copenhagen.

hermes.title: Mercury
hermes.detail: Hendrick Goltzius, 1611. Mauritshuis, The Hague, on loan to the Frans Hals Museum, Haarlem.

hestia.title: Vestals at the Hearth of Vesta
hestia.detail: Jean Raoux, early 18th century. Herzog Anton Ulrich-Museum, Braunschweig.

apollo.title: Apollo, God of Light, with Urania
apollo.detail: Charles Meynier, 1798. Cleveland Museum of Art.

ares.title: Mars and Rhea Silvia (detail)
ares.detail: Peter Paul Rubens, about 1617. Liechtenstein Museum, Vienna.

poseidon.title: Neptune’s Horses
poseidon.detail: Walter Crane, about 1892. Study for the painting in the Neue Pinakothek, Munich.

hera.title: Juno
hera.detail: Rembrandt, about 1662 to 1665. Hammer Museum, Los Angeles.

artemis.title: Diana the Huntress
artemis.detail: Orazio Gentileschi, about 1630. Musée d’Arts, Nantes.

demeter.title: Demeter Mourning for Persephone
demeter.detail: Evelyn De Morgan, 1906. De Morgan Collection.

hephaestus.title: Vulcan Forging the Thunderbolts of Jupiter
hephaestus.detail: Peter Paul Rubens, 1636 to 1638. Museo del Prado, Madrid.
